title: Driver Compliance Verification for Freight Brokers | Indemni
summary: Automate driver compliance checks for every shipment. Verify CDL status, Non-Domiciled licenses, insurance, and FMCSA credentials in seconds — not hours.
body_markdown:
**From the CDL crackdown to new FMCSA auditing standards, regulatory risk is rising. We break down complex policy shifts into clear operational directives.**


**Stay compliant with real-time analysis on non-domiciled licensing, insurance requirements, and the latest DoT enforcement priorities impacting your fleet.**
